text:
maya_csm: Quick sync on SolsticeAI onboarding — customer reported p95 ~210ms on chat route and token spend is trending 22% above forecast. Renewal conversation in 4 weeks, want a low-risk perf plan.
rohit_perf: Do we have the traffic profile? short vs long sessions matters for quant and batching.
maya_csm: Dashboard link: https://redwood/dash/solsticeai. Rough split: ~68% <300 tokens, 28% go 300-1200, small 4% >1200. Long tail spikes batch latency.
anika_se: Recommendation: split traffic by estimated token count at proxy. For <=256 -> compact-int8; 257-800 -> mixed-precision fp16; >800 -> keep fp32 or fp16 with extended cache. Canary 15% on compact-int8 for short-route only.
rohit_perf: For quant approach, prefer per-channel calibration (dynamic quant) to retain quality on common layers. I'll run a quick profile and estimate token-cost delta and expected p95 gain.
maya_csm: Customer explicitly worried about redactions and hallucinations on long outputs; must preserve fp16/fp32 path for >512 tokens.
james_oncall: Ops considerations: ensure KV cache key schema unchanged across variants. Add traffic tag to traces so we can correlate user complaints with route.
rohit_perf: I'll produce an eval against their top 2k prompts. Metrics: p95 latency, token cost, and a simple fidelity score (BLEU/ROUGE-ish) and hallucination heuristics.
anika_se: I'll craft the routing policy and rollout plan. Rollout rules: start 15% canary for 6h, monitor error rate, quality delta, token-drop events. Auto-roll back if error rate >0.8% or hallucination score worsens by >3%.
ops-bot: Checklist: security-review completed, perf-runbook required, rollout-owner assigned: anika_se.
maya_csm: For customer enablement, can we provide a tiny SDK snippet to detect preflight token count? They prefer client-side header to avoid extra proxy hops.
anika_se: Snippet (for the enablement doc):
```javascript
function estimateTokens(str){ return Math.ceil(str.length/4); }
const route = estimateTokens(prompt) <= 256 ? 'compact-int8' : (estimateTokens(prompt) <= 800 ? 'fp16-main' : 'fp16-long');
await redwood.send({ model: route, prompt });
```
rohit_perf: I'll attach a notebook that runs both variants and outputs a concise CSV with delta metrics so CSM can include in renewal deck.
maya_csm: Goals to promise in renewal: 15-25% p95 improvement on interactive chat, expected ~12-18% cost savings on token billing for steady-state, with explicit fallback for quality.
james_oncall: Added alert: `canary-route-errors > 0.8%` -> page oncall. Also set quota guard so canary doesn't exceed reserved capacity.
anika_se: I'll include rollback steps and a probe script that sends 50 synthetic prompts per minute to both paths for automated smoke checks.
maya_csm: Can we aim to have artifacts (quant profile, routing config, SDK snippet, eval notebook) by Monday EOD? I'll schedule a 30-min enablement call Tue 10am PT.
rohit_perf: Confirmed — quant profile and eval harness by Mon EOD.
anika_se: Confirmed — routing config, SDK snippet, rollout doc by Mon EOD.
maya_csm: Thanks all :pray: I'll share the plan with SolsticeAI and add notes to their renewal tracker. Reopen thread if blockers.
ops-bot: Calendar invite: Enablement sync Tue 10:00 PT (invite sent).
